options.name: Religious court bias
options.desc: The religious branch of the country's judiciary tends to pass exaggerated judgement and their interpretation of law favours the establishment and not the citizen.

options.name: Questionable religious court impartiality
options.desc: There are instances of religious courts passing far-fetched judgement or interpretation in favour o the establishment.

options.name: Impartial religious courts
options.desc: There is no bias in religious courts. All their judgements comply standards of correct law interpretation
